# NFL Daily — 2026-10-29 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Bears traded two first-round picks (2027, 2028) and a 2027 fourth to the Titans for All-Pro DT Jeffery Simmons, the biggest in-season trade for Chicago since it landed Khalil Mack in 2019. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2115811793193029664)
- Colts RB Jonathan Taylor said he hasn't requested a trade but conceded his future is uncertain, days after the team dealt G Quenton Nelson and DT DeForest Buckner. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50319874/colts-jonathan-taylor-confirms-requested-trade)
- Jets WR Garrett Wilson explained why he won't request a trade out of New York. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/garrett-wilson-trade-rumors-jets-stats)
- June Jones, the run-and-shoot pioneer who coached the Falcons and built offenses at Hawaii and SMU, died at 73. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/college-football/news/june-jones-dies-73-smu-hawaii-nfl/)

## Transactions
- Bears acquired All-Pro DT Jeffery Simmons and a 2028 fifth-round pick from the Titans for first-round picks in 2027 and 2028 and a 2027 fourth-rounder. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50318351/sources-bears-trade-all-pro-dt-jeffery-simmons)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-10-29 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- DC Anthony Weaver, facing fan criticism after the defense's collapse in Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Bengals, called the third quarter "two quarters of horrendous football" and said the Ravens "need the 12th man" to help stop the bleeding. [Baltimore Sun](https://www.baltimoresun.com/2026/10/29/ravens-anthony-weaver-wink-marintdale-fans-comments/)
- S Kyle Hamilton said the team held "very real grown man conversations" this week, with the season able to "go one of two directions." [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2115896758601478445)
- RB Derrick Henry said the Ravens' "leaders have to lead" as the team tries to snap out of its funk. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/derrick-henry-ronnie-stanley-say-ravens-leaders-must-step-forward-open-competition-to-play-right-guard-against-bills)

- Browns are "less likely" to trade WR Jerry Jeudy before the Nov. 10 deadline, per a report. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Bills S C.J. Gardner-Johnson is on the suspended list. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)

- Bills WR DJ Moore (shoulder) was in a red non-contact jersey for a second straight day and is questionable for Sunday. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
